name: Wit of the Traitor’s Prison
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 5

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target suffers 1d10 points of phrenic damage, plus an additional point of damage for every caster level. Additionally, the target is under the effect of the dominate person spell until the end of your next turn.
